key.name: control-values
key.description: Flat dictionary mapping a "<serial>\x1f<control-name>" composite key to its last known integer value, where \x1f is the ASCII Unit Separator. Used to restore camera state on the next launch.

key.name: preview-default-on
key.summary: Start the live preview on page open
key.description: When true, the live preview pipeline starts automatically each time the user opens a camera's controls page. When false (default), the user has to flip the preview toggle on per session. Only consulted when the application was built with the `live-preview` Cargo feature (T-200).

key.name: ptz-speed-fast
key.description: Scales the per-tick step size used by the T-101b press-and- hold and keyboard-arrow handlers. 50 (default) maps to the original 1° step per 50 ms tick (~20°/s). 1 maps to ~0.1° per tick (~2°/s, deliberate framing) and 100 maps to ~2° per tick (~40°/s, fast pan). The discrete-tap step (5°) does not depend on this setting. Shift+Arrow multiplies the resulting step by 3 for a one-shot accelerator regardless of this slider.
